sentences.text: A second head teachers' union has called for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections in England, saying it is "increasingly concerned about the welfare and morale" of its members.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: The Association of School and College Leaders (ASCL) also raised the prospect of potential strike action, saying a new grading system had become an "overbearing mess".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: On Friday, Ofsted's chief inspector Sir Martyn Oliver said an independent survey of education providers showed it was "on the right track" with inspections.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: The Department for Education (DfE) said ministers were "working with Ofsted and school leaders to ensure accountability is fair, proportionate and focused on helping every school get better".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: ASCL's announcement comes after another union, the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) , said changes Ofsted made to inspections just under a year ago had been severely harmful to school leaders' welfare.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: ASCL said it had passed a motion of no confidence in "the ability of Ofsted's leadership to address the damage being done by the new inspection system", adding that it was "increasingly concerned about the welfare and morale of members".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: Pepe Di'Iasio, general secretary, said the union did not take the step "lightly", but added Ofsted's "warm words about recognising wellbeing pressures... have not been matched by the action necessary" and that "negotiation [had] hit a brick wall".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: "The current system is not fit for purpose.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: It is an overbearing mess and urgently needs to be reviewed," he said.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: Why the shake-up of school inspections risks causing new problems What is Ofsted and how does the new school ratings system work?
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: ASCL called on the government to pause inspections and review the system, and said it would survey members on whether to hold an informal ballot on industrial action if there was no change.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: In response, Ofsted said it had "worked hard to reduce the pressure of inspection in recent years, but we know workload and wellbeing remain a challenge".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: "We are working with the Department for Education on this and we will keep listening to feedback from professionals as we continue to improve what we do," a spokesperson added.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: England's schools inspectorate introduced the report card system to replace its previous one or two-word judgements last November, following the death of head teacher Ruth Perry, who took her own life after Ofsted downgraded her school from "outstanding" to "inadequate".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: An inquest ruled that an Ofsted inspection had contributed to her death in January 2023.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: That led to a change in how Ofsted assessed schools, bringing in report cards designed to grade schools on several areas, rather than focusing on one overall grade.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: An example of a new Ofsted inspection report Last month, the NAHT said testimonies from its members, seen by the BBC, suggested some school leaders had faced "intolerable" pressure because of the new inspections, leaving them "overwhelmed" and "anxious".
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: It warned the system could pose a "risk to life" if changes were not forthcoming.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: An independent report, commissioned by Ofsted to evaluate its new framework, concluded this week that leaders were "generally positive" about their inspection experience, and that it was "more collaborative and accounts for context better than previous inspections".

sentences.text: But it also said nearly half (48%) of school leaders who responded to its survey said their staff's mental wellbeing had been negatively affected "a fair amount" or "a lot" by a recent inspection.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: The interim report was based on focus groups and nearly 700 responses from school, college and early years leaders who were invited to complete a survey following inspections this year.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: A full report is due to be published next year.
sentences.article_title: Ofsted faces fresh calls to halt graded school inspections in England

sentences.text: "I know that workload and wellbeing in education continue to be challenging, and I don't take that lightly.

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.article_title: Online event offers support for menopause and pain

sentences.text: Ofcom is investigating whether Meta breached its duties under the UK's online safety laws with the launch of its "Instants" feature on Instagram.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: The tool - allowing users to take and share an instant image with close friends, that disappears once viewed - was launched on Meta's photo-sharing app in May as "a new way to share photos in the moment".
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: But the regulator said the social media giant had not properly assessed risks posed by the feature prior to launching it - something it is required to do under the UK's Online Safety Act (OSA).
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: A Meta spokesperson said in a statement that it "takes its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously".
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: "We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," they said.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: "We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation." Ofcom said its probe would examine whether Meta breached OSA duties by not carrying out "a suitable and sufficient illegal content risk assessment and children's risk assessment before the launch of Instants".
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: Under the UK's sweeping online safety rules, platforms including Meta must carry out and update risk assessments to comply with a range of duties, including to tackle illegal content.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: They must also show how they prevent children permitted to use their services from encountering content deemed harmful for them.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: This spans material relating to pornography, or promoting self-harm or suicide - as "priority primary content" - alongside things like abusive, hateful or bullying content.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: "Our online safety laws are clear – significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched," said Ofcom enforcement director George Lusty.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: "This is a vital step that tech firms must take to protect their users," he added.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: Images shared with Instants can be viewed by those who have been selected as "close friends" by a user, or those who they follow and are followed back by.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: Meta says the feature has a range of built-in protections, including for younger users with Teen Accounts, including preventing screenshots, reshares or forwarding of Instants.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: But disappearing messages and images have been singled out previously as posing particular risks for child or teen users of some apps .
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: "Safety by design must be built in, not bolted on, and today's investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," Lusty added.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: All three companies have appeared in court this week, arguing they should not need to provide so much information in response to Ofcom's formal requests.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: Meta has separately also argued Ofcom should not be able to levy fines for breaches based on its global annual revenue.
sentences.article_title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature

sentences.text: It also contends that its messaging and image-sharing apps should not have to face additional requirements under the OSA, such as tackling paid-for fraud ads.

sentences.text: A woman convinced her former partner she had given birth to two children who most likely did not exist in what a High Court judge described as an "extraordinary" and "elaborate campaign of deceit".

sentences.text: It said the number had fallen from its peak in the year after Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023 and the war in Gaza began, but remains "substantially higher" than before that point.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Universities UK (UUK) represents more than 140 institutions and said its members needed to "protect Jewish students and staff", adding that the findings were a "serious concern".
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Lucy Powell, education secretary in England, said the findings in the CST report were "deeply troubling".
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: "We expect universities to take a zero-tolerance approach to antisemitism, and are providing training to help university staff identify and respond to incidents swiftly," she said.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The CST defines an antisemitic incident as "university-related" if it concerns a student, member of staff or academic at a UK university "in their academic or student capacity" - including on campus and online.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: In 2022-23, the last academic year before the 7 October attack, the CST recorded 53 incidents.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: That grew to 272 in 2023-24.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: A report from the charity examining the past two academic years says reported incidents fell in 2024-25 and but grew again in 2025-26.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The most common type of incident recorded by CST over both years was abusive behaviour, including verbal abuse, comments made in person or online and antisemitic graffiti.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Its report said that, for the first time, there were two occurrences of extreme violence in 2024-25.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: It said there were six reported assaults across both years, eight incidents of damage and desecration to Jewish property - five of which were in student accommodation - and ten threats.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Around two-thirds of reported incidents involved antisemitic language or targeting alongside references to Israel, Gaza, Hamas, the 7 October attack, and the subsequent conflicts in the Middle East.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: WhatsApp is introducing new parental controls for teenagers, as tech companies continue to come under pressure to provide more age-appropriate experiences for children.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: The social messaging app's new tools will give parents a range of options, such as being told when their child joins or leaves a group.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: It will also let them decide on privacy settings for their account.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: In a blog post, WhatsApp, clarified parents would not be given the power to see the messages their teen is sending and receiving, which along with calls would stay private and protected by end-to-end encryption.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: And it said the controls were optional, which social media analyst Matt Navarra called an "obvious weakness".
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: He said the move was "fairly convenient" for Meta, which owns WhatsApp, because it reduced the company's reliance on age verification by putting some responsibility on parents and teenagers.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: "Meta is trying to show regulators we have a child safety system, we have parental controls and we're rolling it out across our platforms," he said.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: "I think the big unanswered question is whether enough families will actually use it." The minimum age to use WhatsApp is 13 in the UK, although it is higher in some countries.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: According to the firm, parents will be able to adjust or switch off the controls at any time.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: The settings will be "straightforward to set up" using a Pin set by a parent, which teens will need if they want to switch off the controls.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: Some of the new privacy tools include selecting who can see a child's profile photo and who can add them to groups.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: Parents can also choose how their teenager uses Channels, which allows organisations and public figures to send out content.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: And they will have the option of choosing between the default 13+ setting for Meta AI, the app's optional built-in AI assistant, or a stricter "Limited Content" option.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: "All of these controls are being designed to support open conversations about how to use WhatsApp between parents and teens, while keeping everyone's personal messages private," the company said.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: The changes come as pressure mounts on tech companies from governments and regulators to change the way they operate in order to better protect children using their platforms.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: In June, the government announced it plans to ban under-16s from social media platforms, with the restrictions expected to come into force in March 2027.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: It said "highly effective age assurance" measures would be used to check the age of those using social media.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: WhatsApp is currently excluded from the ban because the government considers it a messaging service.
sentences.article_title: WhatsApp introduces optional parental controls for teenagers

sentences.text: England's biggest school leaders' union has called for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections, saying they could pose a "risk to life" for school staff.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) said the change to inspections, rolled out nationally just under a year ago, had been severely harmful to school leaders' welfare.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: It said schools should instead be rated using short narrative reports that set out their strengths and areas they could improve.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Ofsted said it had worked closely with unions and parents to develop the new report card inspection system and that it would continue to grade schools.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Ofsted, England's schools inspectorate, introduced the report card system to replace its previous one or two-word judgements last November, following the death of head teacher Ruth Perry , who took her own life after Ofsted downgraded her school from "outstanding" to "inadequate".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: An inquest ruled that an Ofsted inspection had contributed to her death in January 2023.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: That led to a change in how Ofsted assessed schools, bringing in report cards designed to grade schools on several areas, rather than focusing on one overall grade.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: An example of a new Ofsted inspection report But the new system has faced criticism since it was first proposed , with Perry's sister Prof Julia Waters saying it appeared to be "a rehash of the discredited and dangerous system it is meant to replace".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The NAHT issued a claim in the High Court for a judicial review over the changes, arguing there had not been adequate consultation on the new report cards before they were introduced, but this was rejected.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Nearly a year after it was fully rolled out, the NAHT said evidence from its members suggested the new system is having a detrimental impact on school leaders' mental health.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Testimonies seen by the BBC suggest head teachers are being left "overwhelmed" and "anxious", with the pressure caused by the inspections described as "intolerable".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Although the system had been changed with the intention of lowering the burden on school leaders, the testimonies say the inspection and assessment process had become "higher stakes than ever before".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Amanda Hulme, head teacher at Claypool Primary School in Bolton, said a recent inspection at her school had been "easily the most stressful experience" of her career.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "It was definitely damaging to my health and really quite distressing," she said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "I couldn't sleep and it led to my blood pressure and pulse rate increasing.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Powell told LBC earlier this month that she took head teacher wellbeing "incredibly seriously" and that the system of accountability needed to be "supportive and understanding.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "I'll continue the work that I do with head teachers, head teacher representatives and others to make sure that we get this Ofsted framework, but also the culture and the whole regime, right," she said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The NAHT said the results of a recent survey of its members suggested that the majority who responded felt that inspections had worsened in the past 12 months.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The union is now calling for inspections to pause to allow for a "fundamental review of how inspection works", drawing on examples from other nations.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: In Wales, the inspectorate Estyn has removed judgements such as "excellent" and "good" from its reports, instead summarising findings by highlighting a school's strengths and areas for improvement.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Northern Ireland's Education and Training Inspectorate (ETI) also uses narrative reports without grades.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Scotland's His Majesty's Inspectorate of Education (HIME) does use grades, but there has been a recent consultation on their use.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: NAHT general secretary Paul Whiteman said: "The clear theme emerging across all the feedback we have received is that this Ofsted framework is even more stressful than the one that preceded it.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "Ofsted exists to raise standards for children and to provide clear reporting to parents," a spokesperson said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "We will continue to engage closely with trades unions – but we will also continue to grade schools." Have you been impacted by the issues discussed in this story?

sentences.text: Leaders from the tower mustard project said the plant has been saved in London More than 1,000 tower mustard plants have been successfully grown and planted out by volunteers in London.
sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.text: Charlotte Harris, nature conservation manager at Habitats & Heritage, said: "[We] are passionate about engaging people in conservation initiatives.
sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.article_title: Volunteers help save one of London's rarest plants

sentences.text: "In the core of the reserve, there's an area where there is no light at all in a huge area - and that just makes the sky so much clearer and you're able to see some incredible constellations.

sentences.text: "You can see the Milky Way - it really is fantastic." Photographs taken during previous dark skies events show incredibly clear views of the stars against a clear, dark backdrop.

sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Speaking at Prime Minister's Questions, Burnham said he will set out decisions "shortly" Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said a decision on whether to give the go-ahead to two oil and gas fields will be made "shortly".
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: Burnham has been deliberating over plans for Rosebank, an oil field off Shetland, and gas field Jackdaw, east of Aberdeen - with a decision on the latter "imminent", according to the energy secretary.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: The controversial fields have been the subject of years of debates, legal wrangling and public consultations, with arguments from both industry bodies and environmentalists being weighed up by the UK government.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: Speaking at Prime Minister's Questions, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch urged Burnham "to stop faffing about" when it comes to the North Sea drilling.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: She said: "In July, he said he would approve the Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas fields in the North Sea.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: "If he'd approved them back then, we would have British gas warming British homes this winter.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: "All of the gas from Jackdaw goes onto the British grid, so will we now stop faffing about and approve Rosebank and Jackdaw?" Jackdaw, which is about 150 miles (241.4km) east of Aberdeen, is a gas field which its operators say could be connected to the UK network within months.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: Rosebank, about 80 miles (128.7km) north-west of Shetland, is Britain's largest untapped oil field, which would also produce some gas.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: The prime minister responded: "She asked me what I'm waiting for – I've had to wait for the government process, which was struck down by the courts under the Conservative government, to be fixed because they messed it up, and we inherited that situation.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: "So I will take a pragmatic approach on oil and gas, we will set out our decisions shortly." Speaking at the Energy UK Annual Conference, Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh said: "We have got all the information on Jackdaw and the department has gone through that so there is a decision that will be imminent".
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: She added a decision on the development of the Rosebank oil and gas field will take a little longer.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: The Court of Session in Edinburgh ruled last year that Rosebank and Jackdaw had been unlawfully approved because the government had failed to take into account the climate impact of burning extracted oil and gas from the sites.

sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.text: They also claim starting production would not protect energy security and transitioning sooner to greener technologies would be better for supporting jobs.
sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.article_title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'

sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: GTA 6 will feature Jason and Lucia as playable characters Rockstar has released a new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, revealing more details about what is set to be the biggest game of the year.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: GTA 6 became available to pre-order at midnight on 25 June in the UK and elsewhere around the world, after Rockstar revealed the game's pre-sales launch date and cover art in mid-June.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Analysts believe Rockstar's action adventure could become the most expensive game ever made, with estimates , external putting development costs at more than $1bn (£866m).
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Here's what we do and don't know about GTA 6 so far.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The new launch trailer , external again confirmed GTA 6 will be released on 19 November.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Suggesting no further delays to its release, the video gave fans a glimpse into the missions that protagonists Jason and Lucia will take part in.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: It also featured a new song from French electronic music artists Justice, who were revealed to be the game's original score composers.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The game has been previously delayed twice , from autumn 2025 and May 2026.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: In a statement when the second delay was announced, Rockstar said it needed extra months to finish the game with the level of polish fans had come to "expect and deserve".
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Rockstar said players who pre-order will be able to begin pre-loading it on their consoles on 12 November to ensure they are able to play at launch.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The sixth game in the main series will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: There's no news on when a PC version will be released - it's also currently unknown whether it will come to Nintendo Switch 2.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The game will cost £69.99 in the UK and $79.99 in the US - with an ultimate edition, featuring extra vehicles and weapons, priced at £89.99 and $99.99, respectively.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Physical copies of the game will contain a code for a digital download for the game inside a box, rather than a disc.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Rockstar has not yet confirmed whether an updated online mode will be released as soon as GTA 6 launches.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The game's PlayStation Store listing currently states "Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience" - implying there will be no online mode at launch.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: But given GTA Online's success , external , it will likely exist at some point.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: How any future age verification legislation in the UK around social media and particularly messaging in gaming could therefore affect it, if at all, is still unknown.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: GTA 6 will cost $80 - and physical edition will not contain a disc What we know after the big Grand Theft Auto 6 preview GTA 6 will feature its first ever playable female protagonist in a 3D setting - Lucia - alongside her partner in life and crime, Jason, as a second playable character.

sentences.text: From what we've seen in two gameplay trailers and Netflix's extended look , the story will follow the pair in a Bonnie and Clyde-esque adventure through the seedy underbelly of America after an " easy score goes wrong , external ".

sentences.text: Fans of previous games will be excited to hear that Vice City, which is inspired by Miami, will return, featuring as the main city within the state.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: GTA 6's cover art revealed by Rockstar on 18 June made several nods to the setting with alligators and flamingos.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Rockstar confirmed for the first time that it was working on a sixth game in the series in February 2022.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: The rising cost of development and immense pressure to live up to the series' hype are all contributing factors as to why gamers have had to wait so long for the game's release.

sentences.text: Several months later, footage and images leaked after teenage hackers targeted the company .

sentences.text: "Rockstar has always had its finger on the pulse of music, entertainment, societal, political, celebrity, and online culture trends, and they've never shied away from satirising these things in GTA games," she said.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

sentences.text: Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei Artificial intelligence (AI) giant Anthropic has been drumming up support for its expected stock market listing as it seeks to reassure investors of its profit-making potential.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Anthropic revenue surged by 45% to $16.8bn (£12.7bn) in the three months to the end of September, the BBC understands.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: In common with other AI firms, it is seeking to position itself as being able to generate huge profits despite spending billions on tech.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: It also emphasised safety at its event after warnings by current and former researchers of serious and even existential risks to humanity posed by AI.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Anthropic's revenue has risen in successive quarters this year, from $4.7bn in the first three months to $11.6bn the following period.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: The company also told investors during the event at its headquarters in San Francisco that it had made a third quarter profit on an adjusted basis, an accounting method which ignores non-recurring costs.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Investors reportedly left the Anthropic investor event optimistic about the company's rapid revenue growth and path to profitability.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Alongside concerns about profit generation, there have also been fears about the safety of AI models.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Anthropic has been vocal about AI's risks, with its chief executive Dario Amodei calling on the pace of development to slow down .
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: In September one of its researchers warned of a greater than 10% chance that AI could "kill all humans" within the next decade , and a former researcher said people working on the technology were "genuinely frightened" about the speed of its advancements and what it could mean for humanity .
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: The firm itself said in September it had identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" which could support the development of biological weapons .
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: However, US President Donald Trump has said researchers have been " bringing up things that won't happen " and that in a race between the US and China to develop the technology, "whoever wins AI, wins".
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Rival tech firm OpenAI has also warned about safety, with its chief executive Sam Altman saying in September that his company will not go public this year as it addresses concerns.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: The ChatGPT-developer is also eyeing a bumper stock market listing, which is expected to value the firm at more than $1tn.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Stocks in some US technology companies dropped on Wednesday over concerns around investments in AI.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Shares in chip makers - including AMD, Nvidia and Intel - fell sharply.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: In Asia, shares in Japanese tech investment firm Softbank were down by more than 9% on Thursday.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: South Korean semiconductor giants also dropped, with Samsung falling by 9.5% and SK Hynix 11% lower.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Shares have been falling this week after remarks by Hock Tan, the chief executive of US tech manufacturer Broadcom, over AI spending.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Tan said at a conference in Singapore on Monday that many investors have "no clue" and have set "extreme expectations only to find out that it's almost like they are in a casino".
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: The falls deepened after US inflation data released on Wednesday showed price rises accelerated by more than expected in September.
sentences.article_title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut

sentences.text: Investors are concerned that higher inflation will mean the US Federal Reserve is more likely to put up the cost of borrowing.

sentences.text: A recording device (R) was wrapped in toilet paper and plugged into a TV (L) A Saudi national who worked for OpenAI appeared in court this week for allegedly planting a secret recording device behind a TV in one of the tech giant's meeting rooms.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old engineer, was arrested by the FBI and charged with using or attempting to use a device "to intercept oral communications".
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: As yet, it is not clear what he was planning to do with the recordings.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: But, here's we do know so far.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The engineer asked AI to help him listen in to discussions about AI, according to an official complaint (the document filed in court).
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Between 17 August and 16 September, Alfozan had reportedly asked a productivity AI assistant several questions about meeting rooms and their availability.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Some detailed in the complaint include "how about external partners, where would they usually meet with OpenAI at" and "can you list today's meeting in this room".
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The complaint also claimed that in September, Alfozan used a chatbot associated with his spouse to ask how to build and install a recording device and how to access it remotely.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Alfozan had worked at the firm for around a year before he allegedly made his attempt to plant a recorder.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The room where the device was found was regularly used to hold meetings to discuss "highly confidential technical, commercial and strategic information" as well as OpenAI's "government engagements and commercial relationships", the complaint stated.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Alfozan had no authority to access or be involved with meetings in the room, the complaint states.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: But CCTV footage recorded him near the conference room on eight separate occasions in September.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: On 30 September, OpenAI staff discovered a "surreptitious audio recording device" behind a television - which had been wrapped in toilet paper.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: A camera was placed in the conference room and on 5 October, Alfozan was filmed entering the room and appeared to look behind the television where the device had been inserted.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The complaint also stated that same day he allegedly left an unattended bag in a different room.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: When security personnel opened it, it was found to contain "another recording device" similar to the one discovered, as well as Alfozan's wallet and ID.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: In a post on X , external , OpenAI wrote it had used its own AI models to "understand the device and where it had come from".
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: It also said: "At this time, we have no indications of this individual inappropriately accessing or exfiltrating model weights, source code, or customer data." Alfozan was captured looking behind a television where a device had been inserted Alfozan had been employed as an engineer by OpenAI since July 2025.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The complaint said he was educated in the US and has been a legal permanent resident since 2020.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: He was arrested by the FBI on 9 October and his contract with OpenAI has been terminated.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Alfozan's lawyer William Pernik told the BBC: "Like countless Americans, Mr Alfozan came to this country years ago as a young person with a dream.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: Like every one of us, Mr Alfozan is presumed innocent, and what has been made public is an accusation, not a finding of guilt." On Tuesday, Alfozan made his initial appearance in a federal court in California.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: A detention hearing is scheduled on 19 October to determine whether he should remain in custody while proceedings continue.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The FBI investigation is ongoing.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: If convicted, Alfozan faces a maximum penalty of five years in prison and a $250,000 (£190,000) fine.
sentences.article_title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer

sentences.text: The singer and actress recently completed filming the fifth series of Only Murders In The Building in London Selena Gomez has said vaping nicotine has changed the way her voice sounds.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "I'm not gonna be able to change my voice," the singer, 34, said in a candid Instagram post , external on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "I vaped nicotine a lot." "Nicotine is so hard to quit and I just wanted to say, if you're going through it, or if you're even trying to vape, it's just not worth it," she continued.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "It's so stupid and it changed my voice," she reiterated, then laughed: "So if you guys don't like listening to my voice, that's totally understandable.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: Just don't listen to it." The singer and actress, who has the chronic autoimmune disease lupus, has previously suggested that the condition was affecting her vocal cords.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: Asked about her voice in an Instagram Q&A last December, , external she said: "Sometimes things happen.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: My throat kind of swells inside sometimes.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: That's all."⁠ Lupus flare-ups can cause inflammation around the larynx (voice box), which can cause your voice to become raspy and strained - similar to the symptoms of a cold.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: Gomez's voice has also deepened with age, which is not uncommon.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: However, some fans have fixated on the change, posting compilation videos showing the evolution of her speaking style , external on YouTube.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: In her Instagram video, the Only Murders In The Building star noted she had recently weaned herself off nicotine.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "I am really excited because I stopped and I just hope I can keep it up," she said.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "It's really hard, but I know if you are going through something you can get through it too.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: It sucks." The star made her admission in an Instagram story Evidence on some of the side effects of vaping are becoming a little clearer, although the long-term effects are still not known.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: A recent report from doctors said vaping was linked to breathing problems, wheezing and coughing, dental issues, poor sleep, mental health problems and even eye symptoms.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: Vaping isn't harmless - the nicotine in vapes is very addictive - which is why the NHS says children and non-smokers shouldn't take it up.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: But it has been shown to be an effective way to stop smoking.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: Last month, the pop singer Lola Young said her " breathing feels like a chore " due to the effects of vaping.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: The announcement came after she abruptly ended her 2013 tour to check herself into a rehab facility for treatment.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "I was diagnosed with lupus, and I've been through chemotherapy," she told the publication.
sentences.article_title: Selena Gomez says vaping has affected her voice

sentences.text: "I locked myself away until I was confident and comfortable again.

sentences.text: Hearing about Tottenham 's team-bonding trip to Marbella last week made me think about the similar methods I used as a manager to build team morale.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: While some things have changed from my day, the idea behind taking your players away to a new environment where they will benefit from spending a lot of time together has not.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: I wrote a few weeks ago about how Spurs boss Roberto de Zerbi needed time with his players on the training pitch after their poor start to the season, to bed them in and build a proper team.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: He will have used their warm-weather camp in southern Spain to do more of that, getting to know what is almost a new squad of players.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: With De Zerbi being cut from Italian cloth, I am sure the players will have been working mornings and afternoons to drill in the manager's principles in respect to team shape and direction.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: But that's not the only purpose of taking them away.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: De Zerbi will also have been able to monitor the different personalities within the group away from the grass.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: If the trip has worked then, as well as getting them ready to face Coventry on Monday night, I am sure he will now, for the first time, understand the strengths and weaknesses of each individual, on and off the field.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: When I was Stoke manager, I often took my teams away to Austria in our pre-season for the same reasons De Zerbi and Spurs have gone to Spain.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Those trips were set up not only to test the players' fitness, but also to see how the group worked together.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: I have always believed in building a family togetherness within the dressing room, with a commitment from every player to the benefit of the team.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: The extreme tests that we asked our players to do over that 10-day period brought out an inner determination to fulfil the tasks given them and, in my opinion, helped us through some tough times early on in our Premier League campaigns.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Watching the lads slowly bond together on the training pitch and at meal times was great to see and I found out a lot about all of them, good and bad.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Yes, I have to admit one or two players were short of the character we wanted and needed, but they didn't last long and left with no bad feelings on my side.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: A bucket and spade were not required when Pulis went to Blackpool for pre-season training with Bristol Rovers Today, whether it's pre-season or a winter break, most Premier League clubs who take their players away go first-class and enjoy great hotels, great facilities and wonderful food.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Wherever the team bus goes, it is followed by an even bigger bus with all the non-playing staff on it.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: It is very different to my experiences in my early years as a player, when we would be taken to Blackpool for three days' pre-season training.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Again, the idea was to bring the lads closer together, but that happened in a different way than today's professionals are used to.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: We stayed in a guest house with three-quarter beds that we all shared - that certainly brought us closer together! - then trained on the beach each morning, doing our running sessions on the sand.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Then we played seven-a-side games in the afternoon on a local park pitch, after clearing the dog muck off first.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: In the evenings, we were allowed out for a few beers, with no time stipulated for our return - apart from having to be downstairs and ready to hit the beach again at 8am the next morning.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: That is where things have changed most of all, right through football, during the past few years.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: In the 1970s and 80s, there was a massive drinking culture right through the leagues  - just listen to the stories that came out of clubs as big as Liverpool , Manchester United or Arsenal , when they had teams who not only dominated English football but the European game too.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: In my early years of management, the bonding I've been talking about used to happen right through the season through the lads meeting in pubs after games and after training on week days as well.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Winter breaks were rare and, rather than for a training camp, the only time most players I knew went to Spain was at the end of the season when more alcohol would be consumed.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: That was what British players classed as bonding sessions and, as I've written about before, even the ones at the top level were much more connected to normal society, rather than living in an eternal bubble.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: Now, while they are certainly more aware of the dangers of drinking to excess, as a manager you have to find other ways for them to connect when there are other distractions to contend with.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: One item I am very glad my generation was not brought up with is mobile phones.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: I used to go mad if I walked into a dining room at the training ground or a hotel to see a group of lads looking at their phone and not engaging with each other.
sentences.article_title: Beer & Blackpool beach was how British players bonded - Pulis

sentences.text: I sometimes think that, as a young player, I had nothing compared to the players of today but, really, we had everything.

sentences.text: This variation of the small-sided game does away with goalkeepers and there are also no referees - the idea is that fewer players in a "team" means those three will get more touches of the ball, and score more goals.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: It is the result of two years of research by the FA in conjunction with Liverpool John Moores University, where over 400 games from under-6 to under-14 level were analysed.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "All of the research done demonstrates that those players having more touches of the ball are more engaged in the game," John Folwell, the FA's head of grassroots coach development, told BBC Sport.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "They are also making more decisions and are engaged in more physical activity, so that is the thinking behind it.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "There are no goalkeeper and no substitutes, so everyone is active in the game.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: They are not sitting on the side watching their mates play, or they are not standing in goal watching their friends play.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: They are actually involved in the game." With the new format having only been introduced a few weeks ago, it will take some time before teams and coaches have been able to fully adapt.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: The smaller-sized format can pose logistical issues, with more games and more coaches and volunteers needed to oversee them.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: BBC Breakfast recently visited Collingham FC in Nottinghamshire to see how the coaches there were adapting to the new format.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "We have three pitches going on at once and all it needs is one parent to be at work and you are trying to keep an eye on three games and nine children at once," said Michael Bland, coach of Collingham FC's under-7s.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "It is the self-officiating, dangerous tackles flying in and trying to teach the kids what a safe tackle is." Mick Goodwin has been a youth football coach since the 1990s, so has seen it evolve from 11-a-side games to the small-sided format it is now.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "My concern is you will get one dominant player in the 3v3 where the not-so-good players will not get a touch of the ball," he said.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "What we've seen is the dominant player has been shooting from the halfway line.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "We can absolutely see the concept, I just think it needs a bit of finessing and it will be fine." The guidelines for football for children under seven is that the sport should not be about tactics or competitiveness, but about enjoyment - that is what the FA believes the new format will provide.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: At Collingham FC, that was generally the consensus among those who played, and their parents.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: The 3v3 format only lasts for 12 months, so goalkeepers do return from under-8 level when the game progresses to 5v5.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "When you make decisions like this, there are obvious trade-offs but we don't believe it is going to be detrimental to the development of future goalkeepers," Folwell added.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "Obviously playing 3v3, players can't use their hands but they are still going to be developing skills of blocking, sliding across, needing to get between the ball and the goal.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "They will also improve their ability on the ball, which we know for goalkeepers now is an increasing technique they need to have.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "We don't believe that goalkeeping is an early specialisation position.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: There are lots of examples of players who have come through and ended up being goalkeepers at a later age - England goalkeeper Hannah Hampton, for example, first played outfield for a long time." Whether the new format improves the development of English footballers will not be clear for a few years yet.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: But England are far from alone in opting for 3v3 at under-7 level, with the format already part of the youth structure in Germany, the Netherlands, Norway and other countries.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: Indeed, it is a format that is growing in popularity across the world.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: "It is the first year of adoption and obviously these things can take time to implement and for people to accept change," Folwell said.
sentences.article_title: 'Not in our DNA' - will 3v3 change the future of English football?

sentences.text: Greens senator Jordon Steele-John denies claims of misconduct against women An Australian Greens senator has denied allegations of inappropriate behaviour towards women and accused his party of "nasty political games", days after the claims emerged.

sentences.text: The volume of oil flowing from the Middle East region has almost returned to pre-war levels, data shows, despite the continued restrictions Iran is placing on vessels attempting to travel through the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Seven months after the US-Israel war with Iran led to the effective closure of the critical waterway, the maritime intelligence firm Kpler said that in the final week of September, daily oil flow from the Middle East reached 92% of its pre-war baseline.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: About 40% of the total oil exported from the region in September bypassed the strait and exited via overland pipelines to ports on the Red Sea or the Gulf of Oman, up from 17% before the war, according to Kpler.

sentences.text: Oil exports from Iran, on the other hand, have ground to a halt after the reimposition of a US naval blockade in July.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: The US military has been supporting ships as they pass through the Strait of Hormuz since at least mid-June and US Navy data shows the number of vessels assisted by US forces is up by a third in September compared with August.

sentences.text: Martin Kelly, senior intelligence analyst at security firm EOS Risk Group, told BBC Verify that US support is primarily in the form of "air support to ships", including through issuing warnings and intercepting incoming threats from drones, missiles or boats.

sentences.text: But ships moving through the US-recommended southern route of the strait near the coast of Oman, rather than seeking permission to use Iran's northern route, continue to be targeted.

sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Susan Collins shakes Troy Jackson's hand Candidates running for the US Senate in next month's midterm elections have taken to the debate stage over the past few weeks - with some heated exchanges and stinging personal attacks.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: As the 3 November election approaches and parties fight for control of Congress, some clear themes have emerged, particularly within some of the hotly-contested Senate races.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Here's what you need to know.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Republicans running for office are facing the same question they have been asked in elections since 2016: how aligned are they with President Donald Trump?
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Conservatives who have bucked the president in the past have generally not fared well with voters.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: The president has seen low approval ratings in recent months, with polls suggesting voters are largely concerned with the cost of living and high fuel prices.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: While some Republican candidates have remained in lockstep with Trump, a Reuters analysis indicated , external that two-thirds of candidates in competitive US House and Senate races have broken with the president in some way this election cycle.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Susan Collins, a Maine Republican running for her sixth term in the Senate who has repeatedly broken with Trump, is again putting clear distance between herself and the president.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: "I voted with President Biden 91% of the time," Collins said during a debate last week.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: "The fact is, this year alone, this Congress alone, I voted against President Trump 137 times," she said.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Collins is fighting a tighter Senate race than she expected against Democrat Troy Jackson, the former president of the Maine Senate.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: A New York Times/Siena University poll from mid-September suggests Collins could be ahead in that race by 3%, while others indicate Jackson is in the lead.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Josh Turek (L) and Ashley Hinson Elsewhere, some Republican candidates are choosing to separate themselves from the Trump administration's specific policy decisions, while expressing loyalty to Trump himself.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: In Iowa, traditionally a Republican stronghold, Congresswoman Ashley Hinson is facing a tougher-than-expected challenge in her Senate race.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: She is taking on Democrat Josh Turek, and some polls suggest he has a narrow lead.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: Hinson has not gone as far as Maine's Collins in separating herself from Trump, but she has broken with the president on some policy points.
sentences.article_title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates

sentences.text: During a 13 October debate with Turek, Hinson was asked about the Trump administration striking a deal with Russia to import 300,000 tonnes to the US, followed by several other shipments.
